events.evidence: Two bomb attacks occur in the Bangladeshi cities of Chittagong and Gazipur
Carl Icahn announces that he has hired Lazard to advise him as he wages a proxy fight for control of Time Warner
Mahmoud Abbas, has cancelled the Fatah Primary Elections after accusations of voter fraud

label.note: Bangladesh bombings and Fatah primary cancellation add political risk; Icahn-Time Warner fight is market noise.
